name: blobatar
description: Deterministic geometric blobatars from any string. No dependencies.
//sideEffects: Not `false`. That would license bundlers to drop `import "blobatar/motion.css"` as dead weight, and animated blobatars would silently render static for everyone shipping through a bundler.
//exports: Built JS for everyone. What the workspace apps use in development is not this map — they alias `blobatar/*` back to `src` through tsconfig paths, so editing a curve shows up in the tuning grid on save. Keeping one resolution here means the published package resolves identically under every runtime and bundler.

scripts.//golden: Regenerating is a deliberate act, so the script refuses without `--write` and says why. `check` does not call it — `bun test` already asserts against the fixture, which is the direction that matters.
scripts.//typecheck: CI runs this first, so `check` does too. It is a named script rather than an inline `tsc` so the two cannot drift — a local gate that is a subset of CI is a gate that goes green on code CI rejects, which is exactly how a type error reached a pull request.
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run size && bun run probe && bun run build && bun run smoke

author: Alain
